# Prepare the notes workspace

Ask which local folder should hold meeting notes and whether the notes are
personal or shared with a team. Check that the chosen folder is writable.
Create a sample note with sections for decisions, owners, and follow-up dates.
Show the file location and explain how to capture the next meeting there.
